name: Elektrotechnika III -  High Voltage Engineering
description: In certain industries, high voltage refers to voltage above a nominal threshold.
author: Techdoc, 2026

words.definition: A material or device that allows electricity or heat to flow through it easily.
words.example_en: Copper is a good conductor used in electrical engineering for wiring.
words.example_sk: Meď je dobrý vodič používaný v elektrotechnike na kabeláž.

words.definition: A material or device that does not allow heat, electricity, or sound to pass through easily.
words.example_en: The engineer used a ceramic insulator to prevent current from leaking from the power line.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil keramický izolátor, aby zabránil úniku prúdu z elektrického vedenia.

words.definition: The process of connecting an electrical system or device to the earth to improve safety and stability.
words.example_en: Proper grounding protects the control panel from electrical faults in the factory.
words.example_sk: Správne uzemnenie chráni riadiaci panel pred elektrickými poruchami vo fabrike.

words.definition: in a way that avoids harm, danger, or damage
words.example_en: The engineer shut down the machine safely before starting the maintenance work.
words.example_sk: Inžinier bezpečne vypol stroj pred začatím údržby.

words.definition: In a condition where a machine, structure, or component is carrying weight, force, or electrical demand during operation.
words.example_en: The beam began to deform slightly when it was tested under load.
words.example_sk: Nosník sa začal mierne deformovať, keď bol testovaný pod zaťažením.

words.definition: A cable or set of cables used to transmit electrical power from one place to another.
words.example_en: The engineers inspected the power line after the storm to ensure a safe electricity supply.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri po búrke skontrolovali elektrické vedenie, aby zabezpečili bezpečnú dodávku elektriny.

words.definition: A material that does not conduct electricity well and can store electrical energy in an electric field.
words.example_en: Engineers placed a dielectric layer between the capacitor plates to increase its ability to store charge.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri umiestnili medzi dosky kondenzátora dielektrickú vrstvu, aby zvýšili jeho schopnosť uchovávať náboj.

words.definition: A sudden short increase in electrical voltage in a circuit or power supply.
words.example_en: The voltage surge damaged several control units in the production line.
words.example_sk: Prepätie poškodilo niekoľko riadiacich jednotiek vo výrobnej linke.

words.definition: An electrical safety device that automatically stops the flow of current when there is an overload or short circuit.
words.example_en: The engineer replaced the circuit breaker to protect the control panel from overloads.
words.example_sk: Inžinier vymenil istič, aby ochránil ovládací panel pred preťažením.

words.definition: To supply energy to a system or device so that it starts operating.
words.example_en: Before testing the control panel, the engineer must energize the circuit.
words.example_sk: Pred testovaním ovládacieho panela musí inžinier aktivovať obvod.

words.definition: Able to withstand or oppose something such as force, damage, heat, or corrosion.
words.example_en: The coating is resistant to saltwater corrosion on the offshore platform.
words.example_sk: Povlak je odolný voči korózii slanou vodou na pobrežnej platforme.

words.definition: covered or protected with a material that prevents heat, electricity, or sound from passing through easily
words.example_en: The engineer used insulated cables to improve safety in the control system.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil izolované káble na zvýšenie bezpečnosti v riadiacom systéme.

words.definition: A sudden, dangerous release of electrical energy through the air between conductors, producing intense heat and light.
words.example_en: The engineer wore protective equipment to reduce the risk of injury during an arc flash in the switchgear room.
words.example_sk: Inžinier mal na sebe ochranné vybavenie, aby znížil riziko zranenia počas oblúkového výboja v miestnosti s rozvádzačmi.

words.definition: An electrical device that changes the voltage of alternating current between circuits.
words.example_en: The engineer installed a transformer to reduce the voltage before the power reached the control system.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nainštaloval transformátor, aby znížil napätie predtým, než elektrina dorazila do riadiaceho systému.

words.definition: To remain undamaged or unaffected by force, pressure, or difficult conditions.
words.example_en: The steel beam must withstand high loads and strong vibrations in the bridge design.
words.example_sk: Oceľový nosník musí v návrhu mosta odolávať vysokému zaťaženiu a silným vibráciám.

words.definition: A facility in an electrical power system where voltage is transformed and electricity is distributed or controlled.
words.example_en: The engineers inspected the substation to check the transformers and switchgear.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri skontrolovali rozvodňu, aby preverili transformátory a spínacie zariadenia.

words.definition: An electrically operated switch used to control a circuit by opening or closing contacts.
words.example_en: The engineer installed a relay to protect the motor control circuit from overload.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nainštaloval relé na ochranu riadiaceho obvodu motora pred preťažením.

words.definition: An electric power line or cable that is installed above the ground, often supported by poles or towers.
words.example_en: The engineers inspected the overhead line for damage after the storm.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri po búrke skontrolovali nadzemné vedenie kvôli poškodeniu.

words.definition: To disconnect electrical power from a system, circuit, or piece of equipment so it is no longer energized.
words.example_en: Before servicing the control panel, the technician must de-energize the circuit to ensure safe maintenance.
words.example_sk: Pred servisom ovládacieho panela musí technik odpojiť obvod od napätia, aby zabezpečil bezpečnú údržbu.

words.definition: Able to allow heat or electricity to pass through it.
words.example_en: Copper is highly conductive, so engineers use it in electrical wiring.
words.example_sk: Meď je veľmi vodivá, takže ju inžinieri používajú v elektrických rozvodoch.

words.definition: An electrical component that stores energy in an electric field and releases it when needed.
words.example_en: The engineer added a capacitor to the circuit to smooth the voltage supply.
words.example_sk: Inžinier pridal do obvodu kondenzátor, aby vyhladil napájacie napätie.

words.definition: Full of energy or supplied with electrical power.
words.example_en: Before maintenance, the engineer confirmed that the circuit was not energized.
words.example_sk: Pred údržbou inžinier potvrdil, že obvod nebol pod napätím.

words.definition: In a correct or suitable way.
words.example_en: The machine will not operate properly if the bolts are not tightened to the required torque.
words.example_sk: Stroj nebude fungovať správne, ak skrutky nebudú utiahnuté na požadovaný krútiaci moment.

words.definition: An abnormally high electric current that flows through a circuit when a fault such as a short circuit occurs.
words.example_en: The engineer calculated the fault current before selecting the circuit breaker for the industrial panel.
words.example_sk: Inžinier vypočítal poruchový prúd pred výberom ističa pre priemyselný rozvádzač.

words.definition: The use of a material or structure to block or reduce radiation, electromagnetic interference, heat, or other harmful effects.
words.example_en: The engineer added shielding around the cable to reduce electromagnetic interference in the control system.
words.example_sk: Inžinier pridal tienenie okolo kábla, aby znížil elektromagnetické rušenie v riadiacom systéme.

words.definition: The amount of space or distance between two parts, surfaces, or objects, especially to allow movement, fit, or safe passage in engineering.
words.example_en: The engineer checked the clearance between the rotating shaft and the housing to prevent friction.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval vôľu medzi rotujúcim hriadeľom a krytom, aby zabránil treniu.

words.definition: Electrical equipment used to control, protect, and isolate circuits and devices in a power system.
words.example_en: The engineer inspected the switchgear before energizing the new distribution panel.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval rozvádzač pred privedením napätia do nového distribučného panela.

words.definition: To separate or break a connection between parts, systems, or devices.
words.example_en: Before servicing the control panel, the engineer must disconnect the power supply.
words.example_sk: Pred servisom ovládacieho panela musí inžinier odpojiť napájanie.

words.definition: A device that protects electrical equipment by limiting sudden increases in voltage.
words.example_en: The engineer installed a surge arrester to protect the transformer from lightning-induced overvoltage.
words.example_sk: Inžinier nainštaloval prepäťovú ochranu, aby chránil transformátor pred prepätím spôsobeným bleskom.

words.definition: A partial electrical discharge caused by the ionization of air or another fluid around a conductor with a high electric field.
words.example_en: Engineers observed corona discharge on the high-voltage transmission line during the insulation test.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri pozorovali korónový výboj na vysokonapäťovom prenosovom vedení počas skúšky izolácie.

words.definition: The accidental escape of a liquid, gas, electricity, or other substance from a system or container.
words.example_en: The engineer detected leakage in the hydraulic system during the pressure test.
words.example_sk: Inžinier zistil únik v hydraulickom systéme počas tlakovej skúšky.

words.definition: The presence of harmful or unwanted substances in a material, area, or system.
words.example_en: The engineer stopped the production line after detecting contamination in the cooling system.
words.example_sk: Inžinier zastavil výrobnú linku po zistení kontaminácie v chladiacom systéme.

words.definition: Lasting for only a short time; temporary.
words.example_en: The engineer treated the voltage spike as a transient event in the circuit analysis.
words.example_sk: Inžinier považoval napäťovú špičku za prechodný jav pri analýze obvodu.

words.definition: To reduce the strength, effect, or intensity of something.
words.example_en: Engineers use insulation to attenuate vibration and noise in the machine housing.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri používajú izoláciu na zoslabenie vibrácií a hluku v kryte stroja.

words.definition: In a way that is enough or satisfactory for a particular purpose.
words.example_en: The cooling system must be adequately sized to prevent the motor from overheating.
words.example_sk: Chladiaci systém musí byť primerane dimenzovaný, aby sa motor neprehrieval.

words.definition: The minimum voltage at which an insulating material or component starts to conduct electricity suddenly.
words.example_en: The engineer measured the breakdown voltage of the dielectric before integrating the capacitor into the high-voltage circuit.
words.example_sk: Inžinier zmeral prierazné napätie dielektrika pred začlenením kondenzátora do vysokonapäťového obvodu.

words.definition: Voltages that rise above the normal or safe level in an electrical system.
words.example_en: Engineers install surge protection devices to limit overvoltages in power distribution systems.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri inštalujú prepäťové ochranné zariadenia, aby obmedzili prepätia v systémoch distribúcie elektrickej energie.

words.definition: Materials or devices that do not allow heat, electricity, or sound to pass through easily.
words.example_en: Engineers use insulators to prevent electrical current from flowing between metal components in a circuit.
words.example_sk: Inžinieri používajú izolátory, aby zabránili toku elektrického prúdu medzi kovovými súčiastkami v obvode.

words.definition: A semiconductor device that acts as a switch and remains on after being triggered until the current drops below a certain level.
words.example_en: The engineer used a thyristor to control the power supplied to the industrial motor.
words.example_sk: Inžinier použil tyristor na riadenie výkonu dodávaného priemyselnému motoru.

words.definition: A curved part of a circle or other shape; in engineering, often a curved section or an electric discharge between two electrodes.
words.example_en: The electrician saw an arc jump between the damaged wires when the insulation failed.
words.example_sk: Elektrikár videl, ako medzi poškodenými vodičmi preskočil oblúk, keď sa pretrhla izolácia.

words.definition: The outer edge or crown-shaped part of an object, especially in technical or scientific use.
words.example_en: The engineer inspected the corona around the high-voltage conductor during the power transmission test.
words.example_sk: Inžinier skontroloval korónu okolo vysokonapäťového vodiča počas testu prenosu energie.

words.definition: A sudden electrical discharge that passes over the surface of an insulator or through the air between conductors.
words.example_en: The engineer increased the insulation distance to prevent flashover in the high-voltage system.
words.example_sk: Inžinier zväčšil izolačnú vzdialenosť, aby zabránil preskokovému výboju vo vysokonapäťovom systéme.

words.definition: A reduction in the strength, intensity, or effect of a signal, force, or material property.
words.example_en: The engineer measured signal attenuation in the fiber-optic cable to evaluate transmission quality.
words.example_sk: Inžinier meral útlm signálu v optickom kábli, aby vyhodnotil kvalitu prenosu.

words.definition: The electrode where reduction takes place and where positive ions move to in an electrolytic cell.
words.example_en: In the electroplating process, metal ions were reduced at the cathode to form a thin coating on the component.
words.example_sk: Pri procese galvanického pokovovania sa ióny kovu redukovali na katóde a vytvorili tenký povlak na súčiastke.

words.definition: The electrode where oxidation happens and where electric current enters a device in electrochemical systems.
words.example_en: In the electroplating process, metal ions move toward the cathode while oxidation occurs at the anode.
words.example_sk: Pri procese elektrolytického pokovovania sa kovové ióny pohybujú ku katóde, zatiaľ čo oxidácia prebieha na anóde.
